about.title: About the Promo Set 1
paragraphs: Promo Set 1 lists the 39 Disney Lorcana promo cards numbered 1 TFC to 40/P1, from D23 Expo, organised play, products and promotions and the Disney100 celebrations.
They come from D23 Expo 2022, D23 Expo 2022 Collector’s Set, Organised play, Gen Con 2023, Gamescom 2023, Spiel Essen 2023, Disney 100 Collector’s Set and Products and promotions.

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details come from LorcanaJSON, card images from Lorcast and prices from TCGplayer.
